from pathlib import Path
import sys, os, math
root = Path.cwd()
if not (root / "src").is_dir() and (root.parent / "src").is_dir():
    root = root.parent
if (root / "src").is_dir():
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))
try:
    from openquantum.qft_qpe import *
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    from qft_qpe import *  # Download qft_qpe.py beside this notebook.
from qiskit.quantum_info import Operator
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import display
from matplotlib_inline.backend_inline import set_matplotlib_formats
set_matplotlib_formats("svg")

phase, m = 0.3, 5
u, prep = phase_gate_example(phase)
instrument = build_iterative_qpe(m, u, prep)
display(instrument.draw(output="mpl", fold=36)); plt.close("all")

feedback = dynamic_distribution(instrument)
reference = qpe_distribution(phase, m)
conventional = simulate_qpe(build_qpe(m, u, prep), m)
np.testing.assert_allclose(feedback, reference, atol=3e-13, rtol=0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(feedback, conventional, atol=3e-13, rtol=0)
print({"output_bits": m, "quantum_wires": instrument.num_qubits,
       "feedback_reference_max_error": float(np.max(abs(feedback-reference))),
       "feedback_static_max_error": float(np.max(abs(feedback-conventional))),
       "method": "actual ideal instrument branch enumeration"})

ledger = qpe_ledger(m, u, prep, iterative=True)
print(ledger)
assert ledger["decomposed_gate_counts"]["reset"] == m
assert ledger["decomposed_gate_counts"]["measure"] == m
